title: Surjectivity of the compatible component map
statement: Let R be a reduced Noetherian commutative ring and let compatible maps from its total fraction ring to all minimal-prime localizations be given. The induced component map is surjective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 02LX, finite product decomposition

proof.text: Apply the localization prime correspondence and the finite product decomposition of the total ring of fractions, then identify the component maps by uniqueness of localization lifts.

mathlib_searches.results: Found only generic localization/component injectivity ingredients, no target theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: injectivity or surjectivity component map from total fraction ring to localizations at minimal primes

lean.statement:
theorem fractionRing_pi_surjective_of_compatible
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsReduced R]
    {t : ℕ} {q : Fin t ≃ {p : PrimeSpectrum R // p.asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes R}}
    (φ : ∀ i : Fin t, FractionRing R →+* Localization.AtPrime (q i).val.asIdeal)
    (hφ : ∀ i : Fin t, (φ i).comp (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (q i).val.asIdeal)) :
    Function.Surjective (RingHom.pi φ)
